_about: Three more man-shaped creatures for the meadow, drawn so they can be rigged, animated and cut apart: two kinds of Barkbound (the world bible's armour grown through with bark) and a husk wight, which is a sandbox invention and not canon.

subjects.subject: A monster shaped like a very broad heavy man: an empty suit of thick rusty plate armour split open by a tree trunk growing through it, huge bark shoulders, thick root arms bursting from the gauntlets, a dented great helm with a crown of small dead branches and two gold glows inside, moss and mushrooms on the back, clearly more tree than metal. Close-fitting shapes. No cloak, no cape, nothing held in the hands, no loose hanging cloth, arms well clear of the body, empty hands.

A monster shaped like a lean man: an empty suit of old light leather armour and a rusted round helmet, filled and held together by thin pale twisting roots and bark, long thin root fingers, a few green leaves at the collar, one small gold glow inside the helmet, clearly more tree than leather. Close-fitting shapes. No cloak, no cape, nothing held in the hands, no loose hanging cloth, arms well clear of the body, empty hands.

A monster shaped like a man made entirely of pale cream seed-husk shell plates over dark twisting roots, a smooth blank oval husk for a face with one vertical glowing gold crack, broad plated shoulders, long plated arms, clearly a thing grown not built. Close-fitting shapes. No cloak, no cape, nothing held in the hands, no loose hanging cloth, arms well clear of the body, empty hands.
